facts.fact: Jembi Health Systems states that in December 2024 Mavalane General Hospital in Maputo became Mozambique's first digital hospital, its Hospital Health Information System (SIS-H) digitising patient admissions and inpatient care and replacing paper records, with an estimated saving of up to US$7.8 million a year; one hospital, and no other facility is named as using it.

systems.tiers: Mavalane General Hospital, Maputo, from December 2024
